items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: And Hawks said, well, you create as you go along, don't you?

ctx.x: No, because I've found out two things Stanley (unintelligible) that, what the guys used to say to (unintelligible) me, said, you know, you a funny man with the horn. I said why. Said, we hear you play one night the same thing, and we go back the next night you don't -- what, did you forget what you played the night before? I says, I don't remember what I played the day before, because I'm always thinking about something else.

And Hawks said, well, you create as you go along, don't you? I said, well, maybe that's what you call it. But like he wrote in that book about those nine different choruses. I wasn't there and practicing on nine different choruses. I made the -- made two or three bars like so. Forget about it.
But when you get on -- the band is behind you, and you get that feeling, and they create.
